name: Bound in Routine
source:
Gee's life changed drastically after he and his boyfriend Roger adopted a daughter. Free time flee away, no more being alone - only work, duties and struggles. As days went by it seemed like this is never going to end.

This short story plays a one day in their life, where, by player's choice, the fate of their bond will be decided at last.

[From [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/bound-in-routine]IndieDB[/url]]
